verdict.rationale: Docs show multi-host/multi-session features (broadcast commands to all sessions, per-host saved logs, host groups) implying users can run many terminals each tied to its own host context and history, but there's no explicit documentation of per-session appearance customization, and a community report notes lack of custom font support, undercutting the 'own appearance' part of the story. Missing for 10: explicit per-session appearance/theme settings, independent verification of session-specific history isolation.
